title: Extend disk-preflight tests at native Windows and non-full boundaries
outcome: Tests cover native Windows child-environment selection and lowercase Cargo bootstrap overrides, keep the native smoke independent of mocks, and pin unknown capacity as warn-only outside full gates.
acceptance: Windows-specific tests compare a real child environment's case/duplicate selection with the preflight and prove lowercase cargo_target_dir prevents default-target bootstrap.
The native statfs smoke proves it uses an unmocked reader even after fixture mock lifetimes or is isolated from those mocks.
A focused or live execution with an unavailable statfs query completes its harmless stage while recording an unknown warning without full-gate refusal.
